why_no_new_terms: An English compilation of fourteen separately headed texts about the novel and about an AI tool for writing it. Its 243 new surfaces are the English of terms the wiki holds in German (Core Worlds, Coherence Protocol, Algorithmic Melancholy), the vocabulary of the structural-dissociation literature it applies (Apparently Normal Part, Inner Self Helper, Integrated Information), the ARCHON proposal's software components (Narrative Director Agent, Self-Reflection Module) and scene and section titles. Its readings went onto 41 pages and 6 records; no name of the novel's world is defined here that the wiki lacks.
